quality.note: Linux validation: 55 Rust unit tests plus 2 CLI integration tests, 8 Python validation tests, and all 21 C++ suites pass. The original 128 C++ cases run unchanged in 19 suites against the Rust-backed facade; ported/partial counts are not asserted. Two supplementary suites cover 11 additional C++ cases. Rust production line coverage is 2736/2815; C++ facade coverage is 1319/1359. Region coverage is unmeasured. Source compatibility requires downstream rebuilds; Windows/macOS and release publication are not claimed. gz-sim owns FUEL-01 integration acceptance, which is not established by these standalone results.
